title: factdiff.py detect never records changed_utc, so no source of _fetch_state.csv has a recorded change
goal: factdiff.py detect writes the state row's changed_utc when a source's verdict is changed, replaced or moved, so the change history in git and the source changed mark of a fact read it; the repro exits 0 once a detect run has recorded a change.

run: import csv, sys; sys.exit(0 if any(r['changed_utc'] for r in csv.DictReader(open('kb/public/_fetch_state.csv', encoding='utf-8'))) else 1)

repro_reason: detect's write needs a fetched page: only the test suite plants one, so the committed state file is the evidence a run would leave
